sam: Quick postmortem follow-up 1: we saw repeated GPU headroom collapse during large nightly batches. Split into three short remediation tracks: quota soak, scheduler canary, daytime smoke checks. Owners below, please ack and call out blockers.

nina: I'll take the quota soak (ticket RW-4801). Plan: request +10% soft quota for a 96h window and automate rollback. Window proposed 2026-09-14 to 2026-09-18. Need cloud-ops OK + revert playbook.

own: I'll run the scheduler canary (RW-4802). Trying a progressive reduce in burst_slot allotment and a small increase to preempt_cooldown. Staging patch example: `kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: scheduler-config
data:
  burst_slots: "12"
  preempt_cooldown_ms: "300"
EOF`
Canary 72h, rollback script ready.

li: I'll add the daytime smoke job and Grafana alerts (RW-4803). Smoke job path: `.github/workflows/daily-headroom-smoke.yml`. Alert threshold: headroom_percent < 14% for 5m during 08:00-20:00 PT. Pager includes runbook link and playbook steps.

pagerbot: Linked postmortem https://redwood.app/pm/2201234000 and created follow-ups RW-4801, RW-4802, RW-4803.

sam: Targets: nina RW-4801 (quota soak) target 2026-09-20, owen RW-4802 (scheduler canary) target 2026-09-17, li RW-4803 (smoke + alerts) target 2026-09-15. I'll do a 5min standup Mon/Wed until closure.

nina: Metrics we should capture: `headroom_percent_p5`, `gpu_alloc_rate_p95`, `eviction_count_1h`, `queued_batches_p99`. I'll add CSV export to RW-4801.

own: Also tracking `preempt_count` and `tail_latency_ms` for the canary. If preempt_count rises >20% we revert.

li: I'll gate the smoke job with feature flag `feature.headroom_monitoring` and include a mute window. Alert runbook will point to RW-4803.

sam: Good. If anyone hits RBAC or cloud quota approval blockers ping me directly. Acks?

nina: Ack. Filing cloud request now.

own: Ack, scheduling canary after quota soak results.

li: Ack, creating PR for smoke job + dashboard link once ready.
